description: This file defines the interface for TR-181 parameter management, including data types, error codes, and function prototypes for getting, setting, and clearing parameters, as well as error string retrieval. It also includes conditional compilation for Google Test support.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves the value and type of a specified TR-181 parameter.

methods.name: setParam
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified TR-181 parameter.

methods.name: clearParam
methods.description: Clears a specified TR-181 parameter or domain.

methods.name: getTR181ErrorString
methods.description: Returns a string description of a TR-181 error code.

methods.name: getLocalParam
methods.description: Retrieves a local parameter value and type.

methods.name: clearLocalParam
methods.description: Clears a local parameter or domain.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the default value for a parameter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets a parameter value from a file (GTEST_ENABLE only).

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Converts a DATA_TYPE to TR181_PARAM_TYPE (GTEST_ENABLE only).

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Converts WDMP_STATUS to TR181 error code (GTEST_ENABLE only).
